title: Shuttle Strike
description:
SHUTTLE STRIKE delivers fast-paced badminton action with physics-driven gameplay, responsive controls, and opponents that keep you on your toes. Four characters. One tournament trophy. It's a game that captures the thrill of the sport without the boring parts.

GAME FEATURES

Core Gameplay

• Multiple Shot Types — Choose between Smash, Clear, and Drop shots to outmaneuver your opponent

• Directional Aiming — Aim your shots to the corners, sidelines, or center of the court for strategic advantage

• AI Opponent — Challenge a smart AI that adapts to your playstyle with varying difficulty levels (Easy, Normal, Hard)

Controls & Mechanics

• Movement — Full court movement with smooth character control

• Shot System — Execute powerful smashes, precise clears, or delicate drop shots

• Jump Smash — Time your jump perfectly for devastating overhead smashes

• Dive Shots — Make dramatic diving saves to keep the rally alive

• Rumble Feedback — Controller vibration enhances the impact of every shot

Game Modes

Quick Play

• Jump straight into a match against AI

• Customizable point limits (7, 11, or 21 points)

• Three difficulty settings to match your skill level

Tournament Mode

• Compete in a round-robin tournament against 3 AI opponents

• Every match counts — win or lose, the tournament continues

• Track your stats: wins, losses, points scored

• Fight for the championship title. Highly replayable.

Character System

4 Unique Characters — Each with distinct stats:

CharacterPlaystyle

Hong Speed-focused all-rounder

Huny Fastest player, average power and jump

Ugo Most powerful but slower movement

Ume Power-focused with balanced stats

Visual & Audio Experience

• Dynamic Camera — Behind-player perspective that follows the action

• Shot-Specific Sound Effects — Each shot sounds distinct

• Immersive Audio — Rally hits, crowd reactions, and shot feedback

• Original Soundtrack — Main menu music with randomized song selection
description_short: Shuttle Strike is a fast-paced badminton game focused on intense 1v1 rallies. Unleash powerful smashes, outsmart your opponent, and fight for every point. Easy to learn, tough to master—step onto the court and claim your victory!
